questions.question: What motivated you to go on exchange? (pick the most important one) *
questions.answer: Explore new cultures

questions.question: Which aspects were crucial to choosing your study destination? *
questions.answer: That is was a french speaking university

Additional comments:
How easy was it to find the information you needed to know upon arrival? *
questions.answer: A bit difficult

questions.question: What assistance, if any, did you receive when you arrived at your study destination? *
questions.answer: We received some information by mail, otherwise we had to go to the office of international relations.

questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the orientation and assistance available to students at your host institution upon arrival? *
Additional comments
How did you find housing? *
questions.answer: I found housing through my host institution

questions.question: Did you live on campus or off campus? *
questions.answer: On campus

questions.question: What options were available for on campus housing? *
questions.answer: Small rooms of 9m2

questions.question: What options were available for meal plans or cooking facilities? *
questions.answer: There is a cafeteria which is open during the week, which serves meals at studentfriendly price. And the kitchen had a heatplate and that was all.

questions.question: What should future exchange students know about living in on campus housing? *
questions.answer: It's small and not that social. I will choose private housing next time I go on exchange :-)

questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the housing available to students? *
Additional comments:
How easy did you find the registration process at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
Please describe the registration process at your host institution *
questions.answer: You had to go to the office of international relations to register on a piece of paper. Quite easy.

questions.question: What kind of help was available? *
How successful were you in registering for the classes you wanted? *
questions.answer: I got all the classes I wanted.

questions.question: What advice would you offer to future exchange students about registration at your host institution? *
questions.answer: To try different courses so you can find the ones you find most interesting.

questions.question: How satisfied were you with the academic programme at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
Were you a BA or MA student at UCPH when you were on exchange? *
questions.answer: BA

questions.question: Did you take BA or MA classes while you were on exchange *
questions.answer: Both

questions.question: Please elaborate on the level of courses *
questions.answer: I thought the level of the master courses and bachelor courses was the same. The subjets was more broad for the bachelor courses and more specific for the master courses.

questions.question: How did the style of teaching at your host institution compare with that of UCPH? *
questions.answer: Very different!!! You just have to listing to a professor talking for three hours, and then take as many notes as possible. Actually pretty stressfull and tiering. But the french students will gladly share their notes with you.

questions.question: How long were you on exchange? *
questions.answer: 1 semester

questions.question: Please list the courses you were enrolled in during your first semester. *
questions.answer: Criminologie, droit de la sanction pénale, droit de l'environnement et développement durable, théorie générale de droits et libertés et droit pénal général.

questions.question: What specific courses would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer:
Vælg fag som har en fællesnævner. Jeg havde tre fag indenfor det strafferetlige område, og det hjalp meget ift. til min helhedsforståelse og mit ordforråd. Yderligere så bygger nogle af kandidatkurserne på tidligere viden, som de studerende har akkumuleret på bacheloren, så det var fedt, at få denne samme viden sideløbende med de andre kurser. 

Og vælg også gerne noget du selv har haft derhjemme. Kurset kommer dog slet ikke til at ligne dem derhjemme, men du har en bedre forståelse for faget.

questions.question: How satisfied were you with the non-academic opportunities (clubs, sports, etc.) at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
questions.answer: Man kunne tilmelde sig EN MASSE gratis. Jeg fik dog aldrig gjort det :-) Men har haft venner, som var meget glad for deres fritidsaktiviteter.

questions.question: What kinds of cultural, athletic and social activities were available for students at your host institution? *
questions.answer: Rigtig mange.

questions.question: Which non -academic activities would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer: Godt spørgsmål - jeg deltog ikke så meget...

questions.question: What do you recommend other visiting students see or do on their weekends or holidays? *
questions.answer: Der er mange dejlige byer i området og flotte naturområder. Ja besøg området og tag lige hurtigt forbi Barcelona selvfølgelig - kun 3,5 time væk i tog.

questions.question: How easy was it to adjust to the local culture of your exchange site? *
questions.answer: Meget fint. Havde allerede boet i Frankrig forud for mit ophold, så jeg var allerede semi bekendt med den franske kultur. Franskmænd i syden er meget søde og snaksaglige!

questions.question: Do you have any tips for socializing with local students?
questions.answer: Spørg ind. Det er dig som skal tage initiativet!

questions.question: What, if any, cultural differences did you find particularly challenging? *
questions.answer: No

questions.question: What parts of the culture did you most appreciate? *
questions.answer: At der er kultur for at tage ud og socialisere på caféer, barer, restauranter osv. Man mødes meget ude i byen for at være sammen - det synes jeg var dejligt. Jeg elsker caféer

questions.question: What are the three most important things you would tell a UCPH student who is going to your host institution on exchange? *
questions.answer:
Nyd det mens det er varmt.
Tag initiativ til at få franske bekendtskaber - de er virkelig søde og har lyst til at tale fransk med dig. 
Nyd at du er i Frankrig, og i den skønne by Montpellier.

questions.question: Is there any other information that you think might prove useful to future exchange students attending your host institution? *
questions.answer: Bare nyd det - her er dejligt! Skønt skønt skønt om sommeren og om efteråret!

questions.question: What was the most rewarding part of your exchange experience? *
questions.answer: At jeg har fået lov til at snakke en masse fransk!

questions.question: What was the greatest challenge during the exchange? *
questions.answer: Helt klart sproget og at tilpasse sig måden at tilegne sig viden på. Men med tiden fik man langsomt styr på det.

questions.question: Any other comments?
Do you agree to share your travel report with other fellow students? *
questions.answer: Yes
